issues.failure_explanation: The bound (hope3), ||(I-I_h)(chi_l v_h)||_{L^2} <= C (h/p_f)|chi_l v_h|_{H^1}, is obtained from Theorem thm:interpolationMS1 with m=1. That theorem is stated only for m>=2, and the cited interpolant is defined for H^2 data. No p-explicit L^2-H^1 estimate is supplied. Using the available m=2 estimate together with the inverse estimate loses a factor p_f. That gives |Pi_h^{L^2}(chi_l v_h)|_{H^1} <~ p_f^2 |chi_l v_h|_{H^1} instead of p_f.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace I_h in the (hope2)-(hope4) argument by a p-explicit quasi-interpolant that is H^1-stable and has an O(h/p) L^2 error for H^1 data. This requires a new lemma or external result not given in the source.
issues.overall_effect: The p_f^2 factor in the stable splitting is unsupported, and so are the p_f^{-2} field-of-values bound and the (log k)^2 iteration count. Via the source's own tools these become p_f^4 and (log k)^4, with tighter conditions on H_sub and delta.
issues.title: p-explicit interpolation estimate invoked with m=1, outside the stated range m>=2
issues.why_classification: A contained replacement lemma (a p-explicit quasi-interpolant) restores the stated p_f-dependence without changing the proof architecture. The fallback within the source worsens the rate, so the issue is more than minor.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: By Lemma \ref{lem:split}, there exists $w_{h,\ell} \in \subdomain, \ell=1,\ldots, N$, such that $w_h = \sum_{\ell=1}^N w_{h,\ell}$.

issues.failure_explanation: Only sum_l tilde v_{h,l} = v_h is established. After truncation, sum_l v_{h,l} = v_h - sum_l I_h(psi_l tilde v_{h,l}), which is nonzero in general. The remainder is never redistributed, and its error is bounded only on Omega_l. The claimed decomposition v_h = sum v_{h,l}, used in the Garding step of lem:key_Garding, is therefore not proved.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Show the remainder r_h = sum_l I_h(psi_l tilde v_{h,l}) is O(E) small in H^1_k(Omega), including outside Omega_l, using exponential decay. Then decompose r_h iteratively (geometric series, using smallness of E), or absorb it into a modified Garding argument.
issues.overall_effect: The p_f-explicit splitting, the key Garding-type lemma, and the quasi-uniform (log k) results built on them are unsupported.
issues.title: Modified local pieces no longer sum to v_h in the p-explicit splitting
issues.why_classification: A contained additional argument handling a small remainder suffices, and the stated constants and rates can survive. No new global architecture is needed.

issues.failure_explanation: Corollary cor:Elman uses the ratio dist/norm. Corollary cor:1 gives only dist >= C_3 Lambda^{-1} p_f^{-2} and norm <= C_2 Lambda, so the ratio is >= (C_3/C_2) Lambda^{-2} p_f^{-2}. The resulting bound is m >~ C_2 C_3^{-1} Lambda^2 p_f^2 log(12/eps). The stated bound has Lambda instead of Lambda^2 and a universal constant that cannot absorb C_2.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restate the iteration bound as m >= cC C_2 C_3^{-1} Lambda^2 p_f^2 log(12/eps).
issues.overall_effect: The explicit Lambda-dependence of the iteration count in cor:2 and cor:3 is not justified; it is quadratic, not linear, in Lambda.
issues.title: GMRES iteration bound has wrong Lambda dependence and omits C_2
issues.why_classification: The correction is one line, but it necessarily weakens the stated guarantee's Lambda-dependence. The p_f^2 rate survives.

issues.failure_explanation: Under the hypothesis, C_G2||e||_{H_0}^2 <= (C_G1^2/2)||e||^2, so the proof gives (C_G1 - C_G1^2/2)||e|| <= C_cont||u-v_h||. This yields 2C_cont only when C_G1 = 1, and gives no bound at all when C_G1 >= 2. The correct threshold is sqrt(C_G1/(2C_G2)), with constant 2C_cont/C_G1.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the threshold by sqrt(C_G1/(2C_G2)) and the conclusion constant by 2C_cont/C_G1, or restrict the statement to C_G1 = 1.
issues.overall_effect: The general statement is false as written. The paper's applications use C_G1 = 1, so the downstream results are unaffected.
issues.title: Schatz lemma threshold wrong for general Garding constant C_G1
issues.why_classification: A local constant fix preserves every use in the paper.
